title: FBR Separates Sales Tax and FED From Income Tax
excerpt: The Federal Board of Revenue has restructured by separating the administration of sales tax and Federal Excise Duty from income tax.
body_html:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has implemented a structural change by separating the administration of sales tax and Federal Excise Duty (FED) from income tax.

Under this new administrative arrangement, the management of sales tax and FED will operate independently from income tax functions. The decision marks a shift in how the tax collection agency organizes its core administrative departments.
